text:
maya (oncall): Opening thread — late-night EU hosted-inference spike. Noting ~14% 5xx over a ~10m window; p95 latency elevated. Starting triage.
ops-bot: automated alert -> HostedInference-EU exceeded 5xx threshold; PagerDuty PD-4521 created.
raj (runtime): seeing connection resets from proxy sidecar -> runtime. p95 CPU on a few GPU hosts spiked right before the errors. KV cache eviction rate high.
sophie (eng-sre): can someone paste proxy logs around the spike? need to distinguish 502 vs 504 patterns.
maya (oncall): trace link: https://internal/traces/abc123 — repro script running to hit the failing route (`curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/respond -d @payload.json`).
liam (support): Customer impact: Acme reported timeouts and 500s for their nightly job. I told them we're investigating and offered a temporary workaround; they need ETA ~45m.
raj (runtime): reproing locally with long prompts (>2048 tokens) reproduces OOMs in runtime process, which cascades into 502/500 from proxy. Shorter prompts succeed. hypothesis: large seqlen + KV eviction -> transient OOMs.
maya (oncall): mitigation proposal: apply a temporary max-seqlen admission throttle on hosted-eu (block >2048) and add a per-route circuit-breaker so heavy requests get a deterministic 503/413 instead of cascading 5xx.
sophie (eng-sre): rolling a proxy config canary that enforces body size and circuit-breaker thresholds now. patch: `proxy-config-v3` -> canary 3 pods.
ops-bot: canary rollout started for proxy-config-v3 in eu-west (3/3 pods). Observability hooks enabled.
raj (runtime): also deploy a runtime soft-limit that pages large KV sets to disk and avoids immediate OOM; will push a patch to canary runtime nodes.
liam (support): I sent Acme an interim note: limit applied, recommended prompt-splitting workaround, ETA for full rollout ~45m. they accepted workaround for now.
carlos (product): action item: improve customer error messages for sequence-length rejections and document migration/upgrade path for heavy workloads.
maya (oncall): creating action tickets now: (1) runtime KV eviction fix + test (owner: raj), (2) proxy circuit-breaker + limit permanent rollout (owner: sophie), (3) monitoring: emit seqlen histogram and per-route seqlen SLI (owner: eng-monitoring), (4) CS template + KB article for large-prompt guidance (owner: liam).
maya (oncall): canary metrics: after config canary and soft-limit, 5xx dropped from ~14% -> ~1.5% over 12m. rolling full rollout at 00:10 UTC.
ops-bot: full rollout completed at 00:12 UTC: proxy-config-v3 -> all eu-west pods.
maya (oncall): Incident mitigated. Scheduling postmortem review tomorrow 10:00am UTC to cover root cause, customer impact, and follow-ups. I'll attach logs/traces to the ticket.
ops-bot: incident PD-4521 updated: status = mitigated, mitigation summary recorded, postmortem meeting scheduled.
liam (support): will follow up with Acme with a summary + remediation steps after postmortem.
maya (oncall): thanks all. closing operational thread; leave follow-up action items in the ticket tracker. :thumbsup:
